[[File:Huttairhook.jpg|thumb|250px|Hutt airhook.]]
'''Airhooks''' were a type of single-person [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] that was ridden while standing. The [[Bespin-class airhook|''Bespin''-class airhook]] was a model that gave rise to the [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform/Legends|STAP]].

Airhooks were deployed by [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla's]] militia on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was used against [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]].
